positions.name: AtlasRollbackCadence
positions.frame: what is the standing cadence for Atlas rollback rehearsals?
positions.why: src-1 issues the directive that rehearsals now run monthly, and src-3 restates that same monthly cadence in declarative/spec form (a 'Cadence' field). Both read in the same direction: establishing monthly as the fixed recurrence for Atlas rollback rehearsals going forward — one as the live instruction, the other as its crystallized statement.
